newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude gains ground in late US paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude gains ground in late US paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent gained ground in late U.S. paper trading on Friday, traders said.
Activity was light heading into the weekend, with several key players conspicuously absent.
A full boat of June Brent switched hands at $17.96 a barrel, up five cents from the IPE settlement in London.
Three partial cargoes traded, twice at $17.96 and once at $17.97.
No intermonth activity was transacted. May/June Brent went out at minus 25/19 cents a barrel, while June/July reached as close as minus 15/14 cents a barrel.
